sources.title: GitHub - DendriteLabs/ingot
sources.snippet: The validator's dedup bank, one OpenSearch index per quantization (ingot_dedup-<quant>): scripts/setup_opensearch.sh starts OpenSearch and waits until it is healthy; --seed then fingerprints the open quantization's genesis into it (on the GPU box), generating INGOT_DEDUP_SECRET in .env if it is empty.

sources.title: Apple is in talks with the startup shrinking a 27B AI model onto ... - TNW
sources.snippet: Apple is in early talks with PrismML, whose on-device AI compression shrinks a 27B model to under 4GB to run on an iPhone. Apple has not commented.
